name: Openverse Audio Catalog Integration
purpose: REST integration querying WordPress Openverse catalog for CC0 / CC BY audio assets with direct CDN asset retrieval.
capabilities: Unauthenticated REST audio search API endpoint access
Direct CDN audio asset streaming and download

installation.instructions: Integrated via scripts/sfx-openverse.py. No API key required.

licensing.notes: Openverse public catalog provides verified CC0 and CC-BY audio assets.

security.notes: Requires public outbound HTTPS access; zero credential or token requirements.

approval_evidence: Production certified in Stage 4B audio asset retrieval.
